name: @chethandvg/dynamics-core
description: Leaky integrators and periodic pulses, with Lean 4 proofs of when repeated pulses add up and when they are forgotten.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dynamics_core_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dynamics_core_wasm.wasm
